description: Source file implementing power control functions for USB-C, including GPIO and PWM configuration, VCONN control, and power source setting.

methods.name: vconn_ctrl_set
methods.description: Controls VCONN power lines based on the specified VCONN type.

methods.name: source_ctrl_set
methods.description: Sets the power source voltage via PWM based on the specified source type.

methods.name: power_ctrl_init
methods.description: Initializes power control GPIOs and PWM, configures device readiness, and sets default power states.
